Hi Hannah —

Thanks for taking a look. Quick ask from Gridline: we have Volt Retail (customer) lined up for a 6-week pilot starting Nov 1 and are requesting partner-sponsored Redwood credits to cover the initial two weeks of data ingestion + inference while Volt finalizes procurement. High-level ask below — attached is our standard partner credit request form and a usage projection workbook.

- Company: Volt Retail
- Pilot scope: search re-rank + personalized recommendations (2 models, ~512 context)
- Requested sponsor credit: $15,000 (estimate ~120K tokens / week)
- Pilot window: Nov 1 — Dec 12 (6 weeks), prefer credits applied day 1
- Co-marketing: Gridline will run a short case study and participation in a joint webinar (optional)

Can you confirm Redwood requirements for partner-sourced credits, any limits we should be aware of, and expected turn-around for approval? We can also provide a short SOW and SOC2 attestation if needed.

Attachments: gridline_credit_request_form.pdf (form), volt_usage_projection.xlsx (estimates)

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a quick sync if easier.

Best,
Amrita Shah

Subject: Re: Sponsor credit request for Volt Retail pilot (Gridline cohort 14)

Thanks Amrita — and hi Owen.

Appreciate the clear ask and the attachments. High level next steps from Redwood Partner Ops:

1) We need the completed partner credit request form (you attached — perfect).
2) Finalized usage projection (the workbook is helpful; please call out peak qps and expected token mix — prompt vs. completion).
3) A short SOW or email scope confirming models and sequence lengths, and an expected SLA target (we'll default to 200ms p50 unless you need tighter).
4) A basic security check: SOC2 in place is ideal; if Volt has a procurement security questionnaire we can start that in parallel.

Operationally: partner-sponsored credits require Partner Ops + Partner Programs sign-off, and we typically cap sponsor-funded pilot credits per account to reduce risk. If Gridline is sponsoring $15k we can route that as an external credit allocation; finance needs to confirm accounting treatment which usually adds 48–72 business hours.

If those items are all in order, my proposal: approve $12k in Redwood credits up front for a 30-day ramp (applied day 1), with a $3k holdback that Gridline can claim after usage review at day 21 for the remainder if the pilot is progressing per the SOW. We can also add a single 30-day extension on approval.

Can you confirm you agree to that split (12k up front / 3k contingent), and share the SOW + peak qps? If so I'll loop in Kimberly (Partner Programs) and Vanessa (Channel Ops) to complete routing.

Thanks — happy to sync tomorrow afternoon if helpful.

Regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Partner Operations | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
